notes.subject: laip
notes.rationale: נפש is life-force/breath, rendered as laip (life), not soul.

notes.subject: חרמי
notes.rationale: Crux: 'the man I devoted to destruction' (thing under חרם ban) vs 'a man worthy of death'; KJV inserts 'whom I appointed to utter destruction'.

notes.subject: תחת נפשו / תחת עמו
notes.rationale: Balanced parallelism: life-for-life, people-for-people, chiastic justice structure preserved.

notes.subject: olsem na
notes.rationale: Consequential connector implied by והיתה but not explicit in Hebrew.

translation: Na em i tokim em: Olsem Yahwe i tok: Bilong yu no ken holim, yu salim ⟨את⟩ man bilong olkukim long paia bilong mi i lusim han bilong yu, olsem na laip bilong yu bai i go long ples bilong laip bilong em, na ol manmeri bilong yu long ples bilong ol manmeri bilong em.
